text.text_excerpt: I found this place on a list of cool coffee shops in New Orleans and went to try it. Both the indoor and outdoor areas of the cafe are very cute and inviting, there is definitely plenty of seating. Most of the people inside were on their laptops so I get the feeling this place is more of a work and study space. I ordered their version of an Oreo and an iced dirty chai. Their Oreo is obviously not as sweet as the original and definitely has more of a dark chocolate flavor which is nice. The iced dirty chai was pretty strong in terms of coffee flavor and not as milky as some other chai lattes I have tried. I definitely recommend giving this place a try.

After seeing a few folks rave about this place (not like the raves in a warehouse with electronic music), I decided it was time for me go check it out myself. Upon driving up it was quite easy to find parking on the street which is much appreciated. This spot is great for folks who want to enjoy the outdoors as they have plenty of sitting including a few pergolas. As a wifi junkee who needs it for work, I can confidently say they have a pretty strong connection. What's more important than wifi is their coffee and food, which you can guess is just as great. I really love this cute little coffee shop that is in my neighborhood! Their chai is one of the best in the city! Plus every single pastry I've tried is delicious! My only wish is that it was open for longer hours In the evening bc I'm a night owl ! Haha ;) Now that my schedule has become more flexible I find myself drawn to this coffee shop bc I can get there during the day before it closes! It's such a cute and colorful place inside and out! Although my preference is to sit outside when the weather is nice. They have multiple tables set outside as well as these cool wooden u shaped sitting areas.
